title: The door is built; the limiting factors are ranked by measured numbers, and only one of them is a language problem

what_was_built.problem_it_closes: recall_and_execute_workflow returned None for three different situations -- nothing taught, verbs conflict, sentence cannot choose -- and a caller could not tell them apart
verdicts: ASK (with named options and a reason)
what_was_built.compatibility: the old function is untouched and still returns None, so nothing downstream changes behaviour

the_limiting_factor_ranking.method: each factor carries the number that was actually measured, not an estimate. Ranked by what stops the stated goal.

factors.measured: 0 trained parameters, 0 weights, $0 per task. This system is a skill index plus a carrier. It cannot read a new codebase, cannot reason about a stack trace, cannot write code.
factors.stands_between: every clause of the thesis that begins 'and then it solves everything'
factors.who_closes_it: nobody in this repo. It needs a language model and that is the one thing a zero-weight system cannot manufacture.

factors.measured: no display, no browser, no pointer driver, no GUI toolkit, no Docker. 45 of 47 Unix binaries. On OSWorld 2.0 the frontier scores 20.6% binary / 54.8% partial even with all of them.
factors.who_closes_it: a real desktop and a vision model. Both are outside this sandbox.

factors.measured: at 99.9% per step, 318 steps succeeds 72.75% of the time; at 99.5%, 20.31%; at 99%, 4.09%.
factors.who_closes_it: nothing available. It is arithmetic, and it binds every agent including the frontier ones.

factors.measured: two learned operations from one sentence -> None. The pipe layer exists and needs the trace to record a pipe; it does not compose from prose.
factors.who_closes_it: a planner. Rank 1 already says there is none.

factors.measured: 'unique lines of the largest .log file in <dir>' -> None. The goal must name its object.
factors.stands_between: real tasks, which almost never name their object
factors.who_closes_it: search plus a model to decide what to search for.

factors.measured: 4 near-duplicate skills break selection at |S|=4. 30 distinct skills do not.
factors.who_closes_it: a canonicalization pass that refuses to store two skills with the same operation signature. That is cheap and this repo does not do it.

factors.measured: 7 of 8 asks tie at the top for a PERFECT word selector at |S|=30. 6 of 8 at |S|=9.
factors.stands_between: a user who does not speak the teaching sentence
factors.who_closes_it: asking, now built, or a language model. More cue words provably cannot.

the_limiting_factor_ranking.the_ranking_rule_that_matters: the factor this project has spent the most rounds on is the SMALLEST one. Ranks 1-5 are walls made of missing parts. Rank 7 is a language problem with a cheap correct answer, and it consumed rounds 34-56.
the_limiting_factor_ranking.consequence_for_the_fastest_path: the fastest path is not faster work on rank 7. It is to stop, because ranks 1-5 cannot be closed from inside this repository, and every round spent on rank 6-7 is a round that produces a true, well-measured, irrelevant result.

external_agreement_2026.Binding Constraint Thesis (arXiv 2605.23: the harness -- context construction, tool interaction, orchestration and verification -- is often a stronger determinant of agent performance than the model it wraps; performance variance decomposes into model, harness and interaction terms, and for long-horizon tasks the latter two dominate
external_agreement_2026.theory of constraints applied to agents: 'optimization of non-bottleneck resources cannot increase system throughput'; improvements to non-constraints increase local efficiency at the cost of system-level imbalance
external_agreement_2026.what_this_round_adds: the harness claim is true and it is not this project's problem. This project has no model at all. A perfect harness around no model is a perfect harness around no model.

the_most_useful_thing_to_do_next.ranked: 1. stop adding capability and write the licence that says what this is. 2. canonicalize operation signatures so the catalog cannot self-poison. 3. audit evidence omission in the answers that already carry provenance.
the_most_useful_thing_to_do_next.why_the_licence_is_first: the single largest risk in this repository is not a defect. It is that a reader takes the governance record, which is unusually honest, as a description of a system that does more than it does. The record now says plainly: permanence is real, everything downstream of selection is not.

honest_verdict.against_the_standing_claim: learn once -> permanent -> therefore all problems and any computer use: still false, and now ranked. The permanence is real and is the only mechanism at full strength. Everything the thesis needs next is either missing (ranks 1-5) or cheap and unbuilt (rank 6).
honest_verdict.sentience: unchanged across sixteen rounds of asking: no evidence, no mechanism, no test that could settle it. This round added a door that can say 'I do not know which you meant', which is the closest thing to self-knowledge in the codebase and is still a branch on a dict.
